source.name: DDInter 2.0 bulk downloads
source.gaps: Bulk files cover ATC groups A, B, D, H, L, P, R, V only, so pairs where neither drug has a code in those groups (e.g. spironolactone + ramipril) are missing. Indian-only drugs (aceclofenac, nimesulide, domperidone, etoricoxib, ambroxol, serratiopeptidase...) are not in DDInter.
